verdict.rationale: Qodo is an AI code review platform, not a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its docs describe an MCP endpoint for connecting Agentic Toolbox skills to a remote or custom agent, workflow or application (docs-33), including retrieving and resolving review findings (docs-6), and a probe confirms the official MCP server page exists (probe-3). missing for 10: documented setup/auth and transport details, a full inventory of exposed MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
